title: Three-Piece Nested-Channel Mine Arch Support
description: One newly authored complete static mine-arch support module: two whole curved open U-channel legs on flat ground plates and one genuinely narrower open-channel crown nested into their grooves over two finite lap zones. Four front bridge straps with eight fixed hex-head appearances mark the actual lap locations. The crown back web meets the leg channel back-web plane; side clearances remain real. Every channel is a complete closed thick material shell around a truly open front groove, not a solid arch painted with lines or a reused stone arch with different colors. All seventeen component meshes newly authored with mature polygon-sweep primitives. The passage has no threshold, wall, rock lining or hidden blocker. Static art only: no moving adjustment, sliding mechanism, excavation, tunnel installation, structural strength, rock-load resistance, bolt tightening or mining safety claim.
